title: Drill: looking up data tables and equilibria - 123 school
heading: Drill: looking up data tables and equilibria
intro: Each question tells you which BINAS table you need. Use a calculator where needed.

Which substance is the strongest reducing agent: Zn, Cu or Ag? (use BINAS table 48)
Does Zn react with a solution of HCl? (use BINAS table 48)

answers.a: yes, because Zn is a non-metal
answers.b: no, because E<sup>0</sup> of Zn is higher than that of H<sup>+</sup>
answers.c: yes, because E<sup>0</sup> of Zn is lower than that of H<sup>+</sup>
answers.d: no, because Zn is a noble metal

questions.question: Does Cu react with a solution of HCl? (use BINAS table 48)

answers.a: no, because HCl is a weak acid
answers.b: no, because E<sup>0</sup> of Cu is higher than that of H<sup>+</sup>
answers.c: yes, because E<sup>0</sup> of Cu is higher than that of H<sup>+</sup>
answers.d: yes, because Cu is a base metal

For A + B ⇌ C, K = 10. Now [A] = 0.10, [B] = 0.10 and [C] = 0.20 mol/L. What happens?

answers.a: Q = 20; the reaction goes to the left
answers.c: Q = 20; the reaction goes to the right
answers.d: Q = 0.050; the reaction goes to the left
